fusions.name: Ley Wake
fusions.desc: Your wake flares with raw arcana: every enemy within 2 tiles of you takes a pulse that deals 4 damage.

fusions.name: Spellbound Ballista
fusions.desc: Fires an arcane bolt into the first enemy it meets that deals 30 damage and ignores its resistances.

fusions.name: Sails Full of Mana
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Arcane Ballast
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
